content: परिपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fly round or about, wheel or whirl round, hover about; बिन्दूत्क्षेपान् पिपासुः परिपतति शिखी भ्रान्तिमद्वारियन्त्रम् <ls>M. 2. 13</ls>; <ls>Amaru.</ls> after 56 (प्रक्षिप्त). .²2 To spring down upon, attack, fall upon (as in battle). .²3 To run in all directions; (हयाः) परिपेतुर्दिशो दश <ls>Mb.</ls> .²4 To go to or fall into; <ls>Śi. 11. 41</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To shoot off or down.
